page.overview:
Who is Bulbfish Island Guard?

The Bulbfish Island Guard is a character from Mario & Luigi: Brothership who serves as a minor antagonist-turned-ally in the Bulbfish Island arc. He is a Concordian man who guards the underground tunnel under orders from Chief Leyden's assistant.

The Bulbfish Island Guard is a fat green Concordian who wears red clothing.

The Bulbfish Island Guard believes in justice, but when he is defeated while quizzing the Bros., he opens up to them.

The Bulbfish Island Guard makes his debut when Mario and Luigi first try to check the underground area of Bulbfish Island for clues on who stole the Bulbfish eggs after their arrival on the island. As they question the Bulbfishians, one mentions that Leyden's assistant hired a security guard to prevent anyone from accessing the underground. Approaching him provokes the guard, who stops the Bros. from going any further. When Mario explains that he and Luigi are looking for who stole the Bulbfish eggs, the Guard decides to test whether the Bros. are really investigating the crime.
